At ASP, you combine the energy and agility of a growth-focused organization with the strength, resources and global reach of Fortive. About The Role We are looking for a Export Customer Service Specialist to support our international Export and Distributor markets. In this role, you will take ownership of the end-to-end Order-to-Cash process , from order entry through successful delivery and invoicing, while managing the additional documentation and compliance requirements associated with international export shipments. You will act as a key link between customers and distributors, Supply Chain, Logistics, Trade Compliance, Quality, Finance and Commercial teams , ensuring orders are executed accurately, compliantly and on time. This is a role for someone who combines a strong customer-first mindset with operational ownership, attention to detail and the ability to navigate complex international requirements. What You'll Do Customer & Order Management Manage Export and Distributor orders from order entry through delivery and invoicing. Ensure orders are processed accurately and in line with customer requirements, internal procedures and agreed timelines. Provide customers and distributors with proactive updates on order status, shipment progress and expected delivery. Monitor orders and shipments to ensure on-time, accurate and satisfactory delivery. Investigate and resolve order, delivery and shipment discrepancies. Take ownership of customer queries and service escalations through resolution. Act as the voice of the customer, identifying recurring issues and working with internal teams to drive improvements. Export & Trade Compliance Coordinate export requirements with Trade Compliance, Logistics, Quality, Supply Chain and other relevant functions. Ensure the correct documentation is available before shipment and resolve documentation gaps proactively. Gather and maintain export documentation such as Certificates of Origin, Letters of Credit, Long-Term Supplier Declarations (LTSDs), customs and shipping documentation. Support the establishment and maintenance of country-specific export requirements and customer/import profiles. Coordinate with distributors and their import teams to resolve customs or documentation issues. Support Trade Compliance with product classification and other export/import compliance requirements where required. Escalate potential compliance risks or exceptions to the appropriate Trade Compliance or Quality teams. Shipment & Delivery Coordination Coordinate with Logistics and third-party logistics providers to support successful shipment execution. Track critical shipment milestones, including departure, arrival, customs clearance and POD. Monitor delivery exceptions and proactively coordinate corrective actions. Maintain accurate visibility and reporting of Export order and shipment status. Cross-functional Collaboration & Continuous Improvement Work closely with Commercial, Supply Chain, Logistics, Finance, Quality and Trade Compliance to resolve issues affecting customers or deliveries. Identify recurring operational issues and contribute to corrective actions and process improvements. Support continuous improvement / FBS initiatives aimed at improving customer experience, productivity and operational performance. Maintain accurate customer and order information across relevant systems and ensure appropriate documentation and auditability. You Are What We're Looking For Customer-focused, empathetic and service-oriented. Highly organized with strong attention to detail. Comfortable taking ownership of complex orders and following them through to resolution. A proactive problem solver with an investigative and solutions-oriented mindset. Able to manage multiple customers, orders and deadlines simultaneously. Comfortable working across multiple systems and processes. A strong communicator who can work effectively with customers and different internal functions. Comfortable working within a multicultural and international environment. Someone with a strong sense of ownership, accountability and continuous improvement. Qualifications Required Bachelor's degree, HBO-level education, or equivalent professional experience. 2+ years of experience in Customer Service, Export Administration, Order Management, Logistics Coordination or a related field. Experience working with international customers or distributors. Professional proficiency in English, both written and spoken. Strong written and verbal communication skills. Strong attention to detail and ability to work accurately in a compliance-driven environment. Good working knowledge of Microsoft Excel. Experience working with ERP and customer-management systems. Preferred Experience with SAP and/or Salesforce (SFDC). Previous experience with export documentation, customs requirements or Trade Compliance. Experience with Letters of Credit, Certificates of Origin, LTSDs or similar international trade documentation. Experience within medical devices, healthcare or another regulated industry. Knowledge of an additional European or relevant Export-market language, such as French or Arabic. What Success Looks Like Success in this role means: Customers receive accurate, proactive and timely communication. Export orders are processed right first time and delivered on time. Prep equipment Lock or lower booms, arms, or blades, secure loose parts, and check fluid or battery rules as required. Load and position Drive, winch, or spot equipment onto the lowboy deck or detach/reattach the gooseneck safely. Secure cargo Fasten machinery using chains, binders, straps, and wheel chocks, and re-check tension after initial miles. Route Planning & Transport Follow permit routes Plan and drive approved oversized/overweight routes while watching bridge heights, overhead lines, weight limits, and road conditions. Operate safely Drive in varied weather, traffic, highway, and rough or unpaved site conditions within legal hours of service. Coordinate escorts and sites Work with dispatchers, pilot cars, and site supervisors on arrival windows, access, and unloading spots.
